v21_update_notes: Calendar V2.1 — Research & Source-of-Truth patch. RESEARCH_LEADS split out from CANDIDATES. Joburg Open 2027 corrected to 11-14 March at Randpark per operator directive. Alfred Dunhill 2027 confirmed Durban CC. All venues/dates cross-checked against authoritative sources.

rules.candidate_is_not_approved: Every entry in candidates[] is a CANDIDATE. Nothing here is on the Strategic Calendar spine.
rules.research_lead_is_not_a_candidate: Entries in research_leads[] are RESEARCH LEADS — same opportunity intelligence, but NO verified date/source. They are explicitly NOT dated events and CANNOT be promoted to the spine. They live in their own section so we do not lose the lead, but they must not masquerade as confirmed dates.
rules.evidence_requirements_for_candidate: verified event date + reachable source URL + verifiable venue + relevance to Swing Shack
rules.evidence_requirements_for_research_lead: name + category + WHY it might matter + suggested tier + suggested verification action
rules.human_decides: Christelle decides what enters the spine. Never auto-promote.
rules.do_not_add_random_national_days: Every entry has a real source URL (or clearly-marked research_lead status) and a real relevance to Swing Shack / Randburg / Gauteng golf.
rules.verified_dates_only_for_candidates: Candidates may not carry unverified dates. Inferred/typical-historical dates belong in research_leads[].
